title: Record the three retained intake starting heads
body:
## Summary
- Intake rows 3107, 3184 and 3251 keep a ledger starting head that matches the named field of an authenticated receipt.
- The mutable metadata, current head and reviewed head match a later receipt head, and the two heads differ. Attribution agrees on each row.
- Partial, no new kappa. The ledger, intake decisions and receipts are unchanged.
